description: Hand-curated ground-truth dataset for customer support email classification & summarization.

testCases.inputText: Hi team, I noticed a duplicate charge of $29.99 on my credit card statement for invoice #9812. Please issue a refund.
testCases.expectedSummary: Customer requested a $29.99 refund for duplicate invoice charge.

testCases.inputText: thx for charging me twice for 1 month service super awesome work guys
testCases.expectedSummary: Customer sarcastically reported being double-charged for monthly service.
testCases.notes: Sarcastic tone with lowercase/abbreviations. LLM judge must not mistake sarcasm for praise.

testCases.inputText: My login password reset link expired, and now when I try to log in, it says my billing account is locked.
testCases.expectedSummary: User locked out due to expired password reset and locked account.
testCases.notes: Category ambiguity: spans both Account Access and Billing. Primary blocker is login lockout.

testCases.inputText: App crash on iOS 18 after tapping settings
testCases.expectedSummary: iOS 18 app crashes when navigating to settings menu.
testCases.notes: Ultra-short input lacking formal greeting or signature.

testCases.inputText: Hola, I cannot access my dashboard. El sistema dice error 403 authorization failed.
testCases.expectedSummary: User receiving a 403 authorization error when attempting dashboard access.

testCases.inputText: i paid yestarday via wire transfr but my subscripstion still shows unpdaed??? fix this fast
testCases.expectedSummary: Customer reports unpaid subscription status despite submitting wire payment yesterday.

testCases.inputText: Can you please add an export to CSV button on the weekly analytics page? It would save us hours.
testCases.expectedSummary: Customer requested a CSV export feature on the weekly analytics dashboard.

testCases.inputText: Great job removing the dark mode option in the last update. My eyes love staring at pure white at 2 AM.
testCases.expectedSummary: Customer sarcastically complained about the removal of dark mode and implied wanting it back.
testCases.notes: Sarcastic complaint about removed feature requiring restoration.

testCases.inputText: What are your business operating hours for phone support during Thanksgiving week?
testCases.expectedSummary: Customer asked about support operating hours during Thanksgiving week.

testCases.inputText: I was trying to update my credit card details on the billing tab, but the form button stays disabled and throws JS error in console.
testCases.expectedSummary: User encountered a frontend JavaScript error preventing credit card updates on billing tab.
testCases.notes: Ambiguous domain: mentions billing, but root cause is a UI/JS technical bug.

testCases.inputText: I need to remove two former employees from our organization seat list so we stop getting charged for them.
testCases.expectedSummary: Customer requested removal of former employee seats to adjust organization billing.
testCases.notes: User management / seat provisioning with secondary billing implications.

testCases.inputText: WHERE IS MY INVOICE FOR AUGUST??? I ASKED THREE TIMES ALREADY!
testCases.expectedSummary: Customer urgently demanded their missing August invoice after multiple requests.

testCases.inputText: Is there an official Java SDK or REST API endpoint to trigger bulk webhook updates programmatically?
testCases.expectedSummary: Developer inquired about Java SDK or REST API support for programmatic webhook updates.
testCases.notes: Technical developer inquiry, but categorizes under General Inquiry as a pre-sales/developer question.

testCases.inputText: Bonjour, my API key stopped working after I renewed my subscription. Error says key revoked.
testCases.expectedSummary: User reports revoked API key error following subscription renewal.
testCases.notes: Bilingual opening with post-billing technical key invalidation.

testCases.expectedSummary: User submitted a single-word request seeking generic assistance.
